proof_boundaries: Semantic judgments and costs are scripted controls, never real model or human evidence.
The miniature fixture deliberately mixes English skeleton prose and Chinese control sentences; the Quality edit is a mechanical scope probe, not readable fiction or a claimed improvement.
Native Book acceptance is an engineering fixture with scoped fixture waivers; it is not publication or whole-book editorial approval.
Repeated commands overlap; passed counts are per invocation and must not be summed as unique tests.
The exported case does not inject receipt loss. The separate campaign recovery test in the executed 17-test suite injects provider-success/receipt-commit loss and verifies no repeated Review send.
